historicalNote.text: Hill in the District and fa/tik of Salem, Madras and 3,238 feet in height. It is a conspicuous object in the Salem landscape, with its hog-backed shape and its serrated ridges and is widely known for its rich stores of magnetic iron ore. There are five separate beds of this and the supply is almost inexhaustible.
